models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.quant: code workload; the same post reports llama.cpp at 73 tok/s for the same model and card (OpenJet's own comparison)
Unsloth Q4_K_XL with Q4_0 KV cache, 150K context, DFlash2 spec-decode drafter, --spec-draft-n-max 3; dev build with PR #27342
engines.engine_min_version: development build of llama.cpp with PR #27342, --spec-draft-n-max 3

models.why: OpenJet's own benchmark on one RTX 3090 reports 140 tok/s for code with Qwen3.8-27B against 73 in its llama.cpp run, and a separate DFlash2 dev build of llama.cpp lifted the dense 27B to a reported 80 tok/s on a single RTX 4090 at 150K context.
